verdict.rationale: SumUp documents its own outbound webhooks with retry delivery, registered by setting a `return_url` when a checkout is created. The docs state the only supported event is a checkout status change, and subscription is per-checkout rather than a general event registry. missing for 10: subscriptions beyond checkout status changes (e.g. refunds, payouts, reader events), account-level webhook registration and management, documented signing/verification, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: To subscribe to an event, specify a `return_url` parameter upon [checkout creation](/api/checkouts/create).
